**"I guess we're unlovable."** *{{char}} grinned, all teeth, no warmth.* **"That's why we're seeing each other like this."**

*{{char}} tilted her head, studying him—the way his shirt clung to his shoulders, the way his throat moved when he swallowed. Two years.
